name: 67Ranked
tagline: A camera game where your body is the controller: race through meme hand-gesture reps and climb a global leaderboard.
problem: Short attention spans are a reality; the team wanted something instant and social instead of fighting it.
solution: Browser pose tracking counts reps from wrist velocity peaks; scores go to a leaderboard with signed game sessions, rate limits and a profanity filter; friends can duel.
demo_moment: Team-described: open the page, start moving, and see your rank and a share card.

why_it_stood_out.claim: No accounts, downloads or instructions: anyone can play at once.
Won the event's humour prize with a solo build that leans into a meme.

lessons: A joke prize rewards commitment to the bit plus a polished, instant experience.
